purpose: Place the H10 ADAPT point on benchmark plots at the same y-position as Fig. 1 of the QCANT paper while the separate ADAPT-H10 calculation is stopped.
notes: This override affects only the ADAPT comparison point used for plotting.
QRTE and QKUD H10 points still come only from completed benchmark summary.json files.
If benchmark/runs/adapt_h10_qcant/summary.json later contains a completed chemical-accuracy hit, collect_and_plot.py will prefer that measured value over this fixed paper override.
